text_block_list.text:
In this world,
there are three kinds of people.

“The victors and the defeated.
And then—”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna--!!
Once again, the winner is Gentildonna!

"—The 'strongest of all'...
Gentildonna."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Is there really no Umamusume left who can beat her as she reigns supreme as the strongest—!?

Having completed her three years in the Twinkle Series
and reached a milestone—
she was, as expected, on the battlefield again today.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Fan
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Gentiiiiile!!
Phew... strong again today!
Being strong is the best!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Gentil again, huh...
I already know she's strong, but..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, it's pretty boring.
Being this strong, with no rivals around.
"Ever since Gentildonna started dominating the races, it's gotten boring." There are days when I hear comments like that. But—
choice_data_list: (It's got nothing to do with it, right, Gentildonna?)
(It's got nothing to do with it, right, Gentildonna?)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho.
Say whatever you please.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Even so...
everyone still heads out to the racetrack."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps today someone will appear to defeat me—
harboring such an adorable hope.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—And once again,
shattered by me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho!
Hohohohoho...!
Between waves of applause, Gentildonna's haughty laughter echoed. It struck awe into all who watched and all who challenged her, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I won't let that person have their way
any longer...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I watched your race
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
With all due respect... your footwork seemed
even more forceful than usual.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the title of 'the strongest'
starting to feel a bit heavy to carry?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't mind carrying that burden in your stead, you know.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Let's see...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

In the next moment, Gentildonna wrapped her arm
around Verxina's waist—
and lightly led her into a dance.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You are far too frail.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: H-How insolent!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, whether someone is fragile or not...
We settle that with our running, don't we?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...I was planning to run a bit
as a cool-down, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Looks like we'll be able to take care of that errand too.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah...!

Facing the clear obstacle known as "the strongest,"
everyone hones their skills, grows stronger...
and challenges her with their own unique strengths.
choice_data_list: (The level of strength just keeps rising—)

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Refined Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Lady Gentil, you're so gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Aiming for the Top
text_block_list.text: —Verxina, that was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Refined Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me, you there.
Say that Lady Gentile is beautiful, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Aiming for the Top
text_block_list.text:
No. You're the one! Don't you see
how cool Verxina is?!

text_block_list.name: Refined Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-o-o, you are the one who—
...We're getting nowhere with this.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Aiming for the Top
text_block_list.text:
Ah! T-Then... In that case!
"Settling things on the track is our way"!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
"Let's settle this on the track!
Here we gooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Gentile.
You're... finally going, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
—To the world."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Since no one else seems capable of achieving it,
I thought I might just take it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That arrogance... or is it confidence?
I pray it is not shattered on your journey.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because the one who's going to crush you
is me!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please rest assured.
I shall return peacefully and without losing my way.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Because I have
the greatest escort by my side.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: —I am to manage the household for a while? Did Sister... Did Gentil truly say so?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
She will be taking on the world for a while.
What should be done about the seat left vacant in the meantime—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I shall leave it in my younger brother's care. Temporarily, of course.
He is the one who managed to bring the rest of the family together—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"That too is a form of strength, is it not?
If that girl can withstand acting as my stand-in...
I wouldn't mind entrusting it to her."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text: —Do you have the resolve to take that girl's place?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, yes! Without a doubt.
I will protect it flawlessly. And one day—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
I swear, I'll take that power
away from Gentile...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! There you are!
You guys are so slow~!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe's ochazuke puffed up and bulked
all the way up to the brim, dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I have not.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...To think the day would come where you would accompany me, Gentile.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That land shall be ruled by Me.
...I will not yield it to you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Run well enough to push me further, at least.
—With all the strength you possess.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You're awfully fired up
before we've even started running."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"This is why—
racing is so fascinating."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer.
You have prepared the strategies for our victory, yes?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Perfection, huh.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Do you mean to say that you can prove...
you are a trainer far greater than any renowned figure in history?"
choice_data_list: Huh, didn't it sound like that to you?
Huh, didn't it sound like that?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Fufufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
I understand perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer,
allow me to offer my proper greetings once more.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please guide the strongest lady here...
with your own power.
